hook_text: There is snow in Africa, just south of the equator. Where?
clip_script: Rustenburg. A teacher's holiday photographs. A huge mountain with a snowy top: Kilimanjaro, in Tanzania, Africa's highest, five thousand eight hundred and ninety-five metres. It is a sleeping volcano. Mount Kenya, the second highest, is just south of the equator. Then the lakes: Lake Victoria, the largest in Africa, shared by three countries. Lake Tanganyika, the longest freshwater lake in the world. And Lake Malawi, full of colourful fish.
visual_style: Whiteboard photographs flipping: a snowy mountain, a climber at a sign, a long lake with bright fish, then a map of East Africa.
mood: Breathtaking and adventurous, like reaching a summit.
pacing: Slow climb up the mountain, then a quick tour of three lakes.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find all five on a physical map of Africa.
